title: Add a student
subtitle: Chapter 2 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: A student does not need a PongLens account before you add them.
Open Students, choose Add a student, and enter their name.
Their page starts with a private journal for your lesson entries.
Once they connect, the matches they share appear on the same page.
You can rename a student or remove them from your active list without losing the lesson history you already kept.
